What is This Part?
These parts are the Suzuki OEM Interior Door Handles, Bezels (cases), Lock Pull, Lock Pull Grommet and Lock Rod for both the LH door and RH door.
This is the only kit on the market that allows 1985-1993 Suzuki Samurai™s to replace the interior door handles while maintaining a functioning interior door lock.
EASY TO INSTALL – Installs from start to finish in 45 minutes
NO MODIFICATIONS – Attaches to Your Existing Latch/Lock
